scope: Local alpha.10 COMMAND: exclusive single-action dispatch with mandatory manual review, not durable external acknowledgement
publication: Commit/push authorized continuously on development branch; no main merge, release or environment publication

runtime.installation: Official Fabric 0.17.2 profile, original Minecraft1.21.1 server.jar and packaged intermediary mod in mods; no project sources/classes or Loom on classpath
runtime.network: loopback offline disposable server; RCON secret outside Git

main.target: Packaged Fabric 0.17.2 / MC1.21.1 / Cobblemon1.8.3 / native command dispatcher

results.name: Preview and second confirmation disclose exact template/context and mandatory review without executing or reserving effects
PLAYER context preserves native permissions and missing command fails preflight before any journal intent or effect
Native console command dispatches once after frozen intent and remains in review instead of claiming durable completion
Unprivileged PLAYER command and runtime command failure both require review and never become falsely completed
Disabling policy atomically revokes an old confirmation without forcing removal of reward definitions
Template changes reject stale confirmation; unauthorized reload rejects atomically and retains the complete last-good configuration
Command preview icons cannot leak to player inventory and browsing never replays an action

restart.target: Packaged Fabric 0.17.2 / MC1.21.1 / Cobblemon1.8.3 / native command dispatcher

results.name: Review/intent states and native scoreboard persist across restart with no automatic command replay
Existing supervised resolution requires explicit evidence and closes the journal without executing the command again

asserted_contract: Exact opt-in context/template policy; disabled policy preserves definitions and revokes effects
Recipient rendered and frozen before persisted intent; source/context/template checked again before dispatch
PLAYER uses original permissions, CONSOLE explicitly configured and allowed; no player permission elevation
Native scoreboard dispatch increments once; player me message actually observed; runtime failure also requires review
All dispatch attempts stay INTENT/NEEDS_REVIEW rather than falsely confirming external persistence
After restart no replay; once resolved only by existing explicit admin complete with evidence, without another command execution
Unknown command or insufficient PLAYER permission refuses before reservation
Stale definition/policy confirmation and invalid reload do not leak effects or partially publish settings
corrected_test_attempts: A new unit test initially joined a database task from its own SQLite worker and blocked; only the matching owned test worker was terminated, then the test was corrected to compose futures. Final suite passed with a separate SQL assertion of INTENT before simulated effect.
limitations: Only one isolated command action per reward; mixed or multiple commands intentionally rejected
No automatic external receipts: all attempts require operator evidence before completion
Known blocked command roots do not certify every possible alias or third-party handler; operator configuration is trusted
No tests of external mod command effects, crash during pending dispatch, power loss, load or graphical client
Existing Java suites repeated; full legacy item/Pokemon/currency/checkpoint protocol runners not repeated in alpha.10
Dedicated CRATE_KEY remains unsupported in audited automatic provider contract; COMMAND is not an alternative to elevate permissions or bypass this
